reviews.title: Squeezing blood from a stone
reviews.text: HP makes sure that you have to use their extremely overpriced ink. In order to print I have to use their app.  Now I’m having a membership thrown down my throat and temu ads every 30 secs.  I guess spending $100+ on a printer that we use 4 times a year isn’t enough revenue for them.   (And I can’t wait for it to age out and force us to buy something new) Oh, it’s always 20-30 mins to get that item to print every single time we need to use it.  My WiFi hasn’t changed in years but for some reason the printer always has a problem connecting despite having not being moved in or from my office in 3 yrs.  I can’t live with the annoyance.  These ads and membership services are pushing me over the edge of annoyance.

And this app was zero help getting our phone to connect with the printer.
